shared_elements: tall vertical block/pillar as the carved field
rectilinear/geometric motifs (rectangles, ladder-like or comb-like elements)
arched or loop-shaped forms in the upper zone
excavation setting with rubble and earth around the stone
justification: Both show a tall pale limestone slab bearing shallow, flattened relief organised into stacked horizontal registers, with an upper zone of arched/rectangular geometric motifs above profile animal forms — a genuinely specific compositional echo. The decisive difference is condition and legibility: B's carvings are crisp and fully readable (birds, quadrupeds, a comb-like band), while A's surface is so weathered and broken that its motifs are only faintly inferable, so any correspondence in the lower field is speculative.
